# V0.8.19

Section: Source

**V0.8.19** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on August 30th, 2019.

## V0.8.19

- Feature - Radar component
- Feature - Sonar component

- Rework - Performance improvements for shadows

- Fix - Dock door magnet hinge when rotated and flipped in the z
- Fix - Engine volume being negative with throttle
- Fix - Internal doors no longer sometimes leak
